notes.title: MagFighter - Dev Discussion and Watch the Devs Play
notes.content:
Join us for an exciting and immersive livestream during Steam Next Fest, where we'll dive deep into the world of "MagFighter"! This event is not just about showcasing the game; it's an opportunity to connect with the creators and get an insider’s look at the development process. Here’s what you can expect:

Developer Insights:
Behind the Scenes: Discover the inspiration and vision that brought MagFighter to life. The developers will share stories about the challenges they faced, the creative process, and the innovations that make the game unique.
Live Q&A: Have burning questions about the game? Our developers will be answering questions live from the chat. This is your chance to get detailed answers and insights directly from the source.

notes.title: MagFighter - Let's Play with the Devs
notes.content: Join us for an exciting gameplay livestream of MagFighter! We'll be diving into the action with a special play-along session featuring the game's developers. Experience raw, unfiltered gameplay as we navigate the intense battles and magical adventures that MagFighter offers. Throughout the stream, our devs will provide insightful commentary, sharing behind-the-scenes details, tips, and answering your questions live. Don't miss this chance to see MagFighter in action and interact directly with the minds behind the game!
